summary: Frontend testing of the redesigned Canvas (/projects/DEMO-01/canvas). Verified 7 add-node types (add-node-frame/scene/shot/character/setting/media/comment) all work. FRAME moodboard: uploaded 2-3 images via frame-file-input, node showed correct 3-col tile grid with data-testid frame-tile--, all tags rendered (naturalWidth=32) with object-cover — no broken crop. MEDIA node: uploaded via node-media-input, node-media- img rendered edge-to-edge with object-cover and title scrim. CHARACTER thumbnail card upload OK. Node drag delta dx=190,dy=112 confirmed smooth. Node title live update, color swatches (node-color-#ef4444) applied. Zoom-in from 100% → 130% → wheel to 180%, canvas-fit-btn reset to 100% — all zoom controls functional. Auto-arrange grid worked. connect-hint appears after clicking link-. Save button correctly toggles 'Lưu' ↔ 'Đã lưu'. PERSISTENCE (KEY REQ d): after canvas-save-btn + full page reload, both frame node and its 2 image items persisted, images re-fetched (naturalWidth=32) — data-testid frame-tile--0/1 present. Snapshot create+restore round-trip: 2 nodes and 2 frame tiles restored intact. Picker: 8 pick-shot- and 11 pick-scene- entries; adding creates linked node with 'dữ liệu thật' badge and node-open- for shot. No console errors. ONE CRITICAL UX BUG: right properties panel (node-editor, 320px wide at right-0) fully overlaps top-right control cluster — save/snapshots/export/arrange/fit/zoom-in all report onTop=false (elementFromPoint returns node-editor) whenever a node is selected. Users cannot save, snapshot, export, arrange, fit or zoom-in while a node is selected; they must close the panel (X or Esc) first.

ui_bugs.component: Canvas top-right control cluster vs right properties panel
ui_bugs.issue: When any node is selected, node-editor (w-80, right-0, z-40) covers canvas-save-btn, canvas-snapshots-btn, canvas-export-btn, canvas-arrange-btn, canvas-fit-btn and canvas-zoom-in. elementFromPoint returns node-editor for all of them — they are un-clickable in real browser use. Only canvas-undo/redo/zoom-out remain accessible. Fix: shift the top-right cluster left by 21rem (or change its container to right-[21rem]) whenever selNode is set, OR render it inside the same flex layout so it can't overlap, OR reduce panel to a floating card that doesn't extend to the top.

issues: All new nodes stack at the exact center; user must drag them apart to work with them. Consider adding a small pseudo-random offset (already 26px * (nodes.length % 6)) larger, or arrange after add.

action_items: CRITICAL: fix panel/cluster overlap so all top-right control cluster buttons remain clickable when a node is selected (see selectors above).

Minor: DropdownMenu (canvas-arrange-btn) occasionally does not render arrange-grid/arrange-tree items after trigger click during rapid interactions (Radix state). Not reproducible on first click of a fresh session; retry hides it.
critical_code_review_comments: Canvas.jsx: top-right cluster is absolutely positioned inside the same board wrap as node-editor (also absolutely positioned right-0, w-80). Both are z-40 and cluster is rendered BEFORE panel in JSX → panel wins the paint order → covers cluster. Either use `right: selNode ? '21rem' : '1rem'` on cluster, or wrap both in a flex layout.

Canvas.jsx exportPng() creates an anchor with dataURL and calls a.click(); the anchor is not appended to the DOM. Works in Chrome for small images but not reliably in all browsers. Consider URL.createObjectURL(blob) + append/remove pattern.

Canvas.jsx frame-file-input onChange checks `selNode?.type === 'frame'` — if user rapidly selects another node between opening picker and returning files, upload is silently dropped. Consider passing the target frame id via closure captured on click.

canvas.py Node.model_config extra='allow' is good but PUT uses model_dump() without by_alias=False/exclude_none — fine, but response uses `clean(res)` which strips _id from top-level canvas but nested nodes could still contain server-side keys if any. Currently safe since nodes are only client-sourced.

GET /canvas/media/{id} accepts token via cookie/bearer/query param `auth`. The query-string form leaks token in access logs — used because can't send httpOnly cookies cross-site. Since cookie IS being sent same-site in current preview (verified: images render on reload), consider removing the `auth` query fallback to reduce leakage risk.
Canvas 3-col frame moodboard tiles use aspect-square, but many production stills are 16:9 — considering aspect-video or masonry could look more Figma-like for moodboards.
Both panel and cluster use z-40; property `data-testid=canvas-add-toolbar` bottom-center at z-40 too — visually OK but same z-index for overlapping regions is fragile; assign explicit z levels.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% features verified; 1 critical UX bug (panel/cluster overlap)

rca of the issue: Panel/cluster overlap: both are absolute inside the same relative wrap div, both z-40, panel is w-80 anchored right-0/top-0/h-full and cluster is right-4/top-4. Panel rect [1280,125,1600,973] fully contains cluster rect ~[1100,151,1580,197]. Because node-editor appears AFTER the cluster in JSX (rendered later), it wins hit-testing at overlapping points. Reproduction: open canvas, click any node — the properties panel opens and immediately hides save/snapshot/export/arrange/fit/zoom-in. Mitigation: apply `style={{ right: selNode && canEdit ? '21rem' : '1rem' }}` on the cluster wrapper (or class `right-[21rem]` conditionally).
